3.

The present anticipatory bail cancellation application has been filed for cancelling the anticipatory bail granted to opposite party nos.2, 3 and 4 by this Court vide order dated 17.04.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.4234 of 2023 (Aishwarya and 2 Others Smt Kirti Verma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116951563/

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that opposite party nos.2, 3 and 4 were granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 17.04.2023 and they have misused the said bail as they had threatened the applicant of dire consequences and have assaulted her as FIR No.365 of 2023 was instituted against them on 15.08.2023, as such, the anticipatory bail granted to opposite party nos.2, 3 and 4 may be cancelled.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for opposite party nos.2, 3 and 4 has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail cancellation application on the ground that the said FIR is just misuse of the process of Court and it is an effort by the applicant to force opposite party nos.2, 3 and 4 to compromise.
There is no injury sustained by the applicant in the said incident dated 05.07.2023.
The FIR itself is delayed by more than one month as an afterthought, as such, the instant anticipatory bail cancellation application may be dismissed.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the said FIR instituted subsequent to the institution of the instant FIR is delayed by 40 days, I do not find it a fit case for setting-aside the order dated 17.04.2023 passed by this Court.
7. The present anticipatory bail cancellation application is hereby found devoid of merits and is accordingly rejected.

Order Date :- 11.11.2024 Ravi/-
(Justice Krishan Pahal)
